name: Skeledirge
description: Skeledirge, the Singer Pokémon, and the evolved form of Crocalor. A Fire and Ghost type.
pokedex_entries: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge's head gained a soul.
Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
